verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a CLI, SDK and REST API covering the whole platform, but every documented operation acts on one item, such as `start_instance(id=12345)`. Nothing shows a native bulk command for acting on many instances, volumes or keys at once. Scripting loops over the API would be a developer building block, and multi-result offer search is querying rather than a bulk action, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
